historical_references.reference: The god Shiva is referred to as Ishvara, the lord, and Eeswar, the lord of the universe in Hinduism. This name signifies the supreme controller, the ruler of the cosmos.

Eeswar is also considered an aspect of Shiva, the god of destruction, in Hinduism. He is depicted as the creator and sustainer of the universe, as well as the destroyer when necessary. This trinity of creation, preservation, and destruction is known as the Trimurti.
